Apple Cash–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Apple Cash listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe peer-to-peer cash in Wallet — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Apple Cash vs 苹果现金

US pages use "Apple Cash" or "Send & Receive with Apple Cash." China storefront copy often uses 苹果现金 alongside the product name Apple Cash where appropriate on screenshot overlays — especially on balance and transfer frames under Wallet & Apple Pay.

Send & Receive & 发送和接收

Person-to-person payment flows appear frequently on Apple Cash screenshots. Chinese buyers expect 发送和接收 for send-and-receive money frames — not English "Send" badges that hide what the app actually markets.

Apple Cash card & 现金卡

The virtual Apple Cash card surface uses 现金卡 on gallery frames that show the card UI — distinct from payment cards stored on the Wallet home screen (银行卡 on the Wallet guide) or tap-to-pay checkout (Apple Pay guide).

Add money, transfer to bank & 添加金额 / 转入银行

US pages use "Add Money" and "Transfer to Bank" on funding and withdrawal frames. Chinese App Store copy commonly uses 添加金额 and 转入银行 when that matches your English source — describing the cash-management surface your gallery shows, not bank account setup we do not deliver.

Balance & Daily Cash & 余额

Balance displays use 余额 on screenshot overlays. When your English listing mentions Daily Cash only as cashback credited to Apple Cash — not as a standalone Apple Card benefit page — zh-Hans copy should describe that landing path without inventing Apple Card credit-card claims.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Apple Cash–relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 苹果现金, 转账, and 余额 each signal different intent from generic payment or Wallet keywords.

Does integrating Apple Cash auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Person-to-person Apple Cash flows, balance screens, or Daily Cash landing in Apple Cash control runtime behavior inside Wallet — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Apple Cash, send and receive, Apple Cash card, add money, transfer to bank, balance, 苹果现金, 发送和接收, 现金卡, 添加金额, 转入银行, and 余额 — rewritten from your English originals.

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. Apple Cash enrollment, identity verification, bank linking, and Wallet.framework integration are engineering and banking tasks outside AppLocale scope.

Apple Cash listing copy covers Settings → Wallet & Apple Pay → Apple Cash — send and receive, cash card, add money, transfer to bank, and balance on gallery frames. Apple Wallet listing copy covers the digital wallet home screen and card stack. Apple Pay listing copy covers tap-to-pay checkout. Why do my Apple Cash screenshot captions still say Send in English on China?

Should zh-Hans copy use 苹果现金 or Apple Pay phrasing?

苹果现金 and 发送和接收 fit Apple Cash peer-to-peer marketing. 苹果支付 fits checkout sheets on the Apple Pay guide. 钱包 fits Wallet card-stack marketing. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
